technicalValues.hint: All our products are handmade. These values are estimates and may differ from the final product.

technicalValues.weight: The weight includes the product and the TripleZero compression sack supplied with it.

Please enter your billing address.
By default, your order will be shipped to the billing address. If you want delivery to a different address, you can specify it by unchecking the option below.

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: Choose your payment method to complete your order.
payment.comment: If you want to add a comment, ask a question, request or provide details, do it below:

phone.title: Payment by credit card (by phone)
phone.description: With this payment method, you pay the total amount of your order by providing your card number and expiration date by phone at {phone}
phone.openingHours: During our opening hours: Tuesday to Friday from 9 am to 12 pm and from 2 pm to 7 pm, and Saturday morning from 9 am to 12 pm (closed on Monday). We are mail order certified so you can safely provide this information.

check.title: Payment by check
check.description: You must pay the full amount of your order.
check.description2: We accept French bank or postal checks, denominated in Euros, payable to TRIPLEZERO. Print the confirmation email you will receive, attach your check and send everything to: TRIPLE ZERO - 1 Chemin de la Fontaine - F-81540 DURFORT Your order preparation will begin upon receipt and clearance of your payment (usually 4 working days).

transfer.title: Payment by bank transfer
transfer.description: Please pay the full amount of your order by bank transfer.
transfer.description2: Your order preparation will start upon receipt of your payment.
